description: Server-side schema validation of a project config. Returns { valid: true/false, errors: [...] } with the JSON path, keyword, and message for each issue. Prefer local validation against get_schema during authoring; use this as a ground-truth check, including on an amended model before handing it back to the user as a file. Pass exactly one of inline `project` or a base64-gzipped `project_gz` (if the inline form is too large for your client); passing neither or both returns an error result.

project_gz.description: Optional. Base64-encoded gzip of the project JSON, used as an alternative to inline `project` when the caller cannot fit the full payload in a single tool argument. Mutually exclusive with `project`. Pricing JSON typically compresses 5-10x.
